d: Arkan Marketing Services is looking for an experienced Fashion Buyer to develop the product range for a fashion e-commerce business. You will turn trend research and customer insights into commercially strong product selections, category plans and buying proposals, and follow approved products through to launch.
q: Proven hands-on buying and merchandising experience in fashion, footwear, handbags, accessories, jewellery or multi-brand retail.
Evidence of product selections or ranges you personally developed, with clear commercial results.
Strong fashion judgement, trend awareness and understanding of customer preferences.
Practical experience in assortment planning, buying quantities, sales analysis, pricing and margin calculations.
Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and experience using sales and inventory data to make buying decisions.
Strong organisation, supplier communication and independent follow-through.
Knowledge of Qatar or GCC customer preferences is an advantage.
Strong English communication skills; Arabic is an advantage.
r: Research fashion trends, customer demand, competitor ranges and emerging product opportunities.
Identify gaps in existing categories and recommend relevant brands, products, styles and colours.
Develop category and assortment plans covering brand mix, price points, core products and new products to test.
Recommend initial and replenishment quantities by product, size and colour using sales, existing stock, incoming orders, lead times and budget.
Evaluate product costs, recommend selling prices and target margins, and prepare buying proposals for approval.
Identify complementary products and higher-priced alternatives to support cross-selling, upselling and basket growth.
Coordinate product specifications, samples, costs, availability and delivery timing with the sourcing and procurement team.
Monitor sales, sell-through, margins, returns and stock ageing; recommend reorders, range changes and products to discontinue.
Maintain clear product shortlists and buying plans, and follow approved selections through purchasing, availability and launch.
x: Send your CV to career@arkanmktg.com with the subject line “Fashion Buyer”.

Include the categories and brands you have bought, and two examples of products or ranges you personally selected. Briefly explain your contribution, the results achieved, and your earliest joining date.

d: Reports to: Construction Manager / Tunnelling Manager

The Lifting Supervisor is responsible for the safe planning, coordination, supervision and execution of lifting operations associated with Horizontal Directional Drilling (HDD), microtunnelling, shaft works and associated construction activities.

The role ensures that lifting operations are carried out in accordance with approved lifting plans, RAMS, project procedures, manufacturers' requirements and applicable Bahrain health and safety requirements.
q: Experience with deep shafts and blind lifting operations.
Experience handling tunnel pipes and heavy tunnelling machinery.
Experience with crawler and mobile cranes.
NEBOSH, IOSH or equivalent HSE training.
ability to read crane load charts;
experience working around heavy tunnelling equipment.
We are one of the UK's leading civil engineering and tunnelling contractors, offering a wide range of construction and specialist services.
r: Supervise all lifting operations associated with HDD, microtunnelling and shaft activities.
Conduct pre-lift briefings/toolbox talks with crane operators, riggers and banksmen before lifting activities commence.
Ensure the correct crane, lifting accessories, rigging arrangement and lifting method are used.
Verify crane capacity against lifting radius, boom configuration, load weight and ground conditions.
Confirm operators, riggers and banksmen hold appropriate competency certification.
Inspect the work area before lifting, including:
Confirm lifting equipment and accessories have valid inspection/test certification and are within their SWL/WLL.
Ensure lifting accessories are correctly selected for the load, including slings, shackles, spreader beams, lifting beams and chain blocks.
Establish and maintain effective exclusion zones around lifting operations.
Maintain clear communication between the crane operator, banksman/signaller and lifting team.
Stop any lifting operation where conditions differ from the approved lifting plan or where the operation becomes unsafe.
Supervise lifting and handling associated with
lifting and positioning equipment within HDD entry and exit areas.
lowering and recovering equipment from launch and reception shafts.
The Lifting Supervisor shall review the approved lift plan before work starts and verify that actual site conditions correspond with the plan.
load weight and centre of gravity;
interaction with other plant and activities.
Responsible for checking and maintaining site records including
Recognised Lifting Supervisor qualification/certification suitable for the project and accepted in Bahrain.
Minimum 5 years' lifting experience, preferably within heavy civil engineering, utilities, tunnelling, HDD, pipeline or shaft construction.
Practical knowledge of mobile crane operations and crane load charts.
Ability to understand lifting plans and rigging drawings.
Good understanding of SWL/WLL, sling angles, load centres of gravity and crane working radius.

d: We are looking for a goal-driven, fashion-forward Sales Representative to expand the presence of our color contact lens brand. You will drive account acquisition and sales growth across optical retailers, beauty stores, pharmacies, and e-commerce partners.

The ideal candidate combines a strong commercial and marketing foundation with experience in fashion, beauty, or cosmetics. You are passionate about consumer trends, skilled at developing lasting business relationships, and motivated to deliver revenue growth.
q: Education: Bachelor s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
Experience: Minimum 3 years of proven sales experience, ideally in B2B or trade sales.
Industry background: Prior experience in fashion, beauty, or cosmetics is required.
Communication: Excellent presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Commercial mindset: Strong understanding of sales metrics, trade margins, product positioning, and visual merchandising.
r: Sales & account management: Identify, target, and onboard new retail accounts across relevant channels.
Relationship building: Maintain and grow customer relationships to drive repeat orders and increase sales.
Market & trend analysis: Monitor beauty and eye-care trends, competitor activity, and customer feedback to identify new opportunities.
Product presentations: Deliver product presentations and promotional demonstrations to retail teams and prospective clients.
In-store marketing: Implement and optimize point-of-sale (POS) and merchandising materials to strengthen brand visibility.
Promotional execution: Collaborate with marketing teams on trade promotions, in-store merchandising, and co-marketing campaigns.
Pipeline & forecasting: Monitor pipeline activity and sales targets; prepare regular sales reports and demand forecasts.
